name: shared-memory
//dependencies: Runtime deps a deployed install genuinely needs on disk. preact is here rather than in devDependencies so `bun install --production` on a deployed clone installs it — the assistant's monitor builds apps/knowledge/src against it.
//peerDependencies: Supplied by the host as a generated shim in the workspace's node_modules. It must NEVER be installed into this plugin's own node_modules on a deployed install: Node resolves the nearest copy, so a real package here shadows the host shim and every host-injected function resolves to undefined. See README, 'Installing dependencies on a deployed install'.
//devDependencies: Local development only — typechecking and tests. The plugin-api entry here is what a bare `bun install` would wrongly place in a deployed install's node_modules.
